libdexfile.reason: Windows keeps the DEX implementation internal to ART and dex2oat until its C++ PE ABI and ownership annotations are reviewed.

libicuuc_stubdata.reason: Windows ICU common is a DLL and imports icudt72_dat through ICU's U_DATA_API contract; the stub-data DLL owns that required PE data-import boundary while Linux folds the zero-data stub into its shared ICU closure.

libprofile.reason: Windows keeps profile implementation internal to ART and dex2oat until a stable PE export/import boundary is defined.

libunwindstack.reason: Windows embeds the adapted unwinder in its consumers because the port has no reviewed standalone libunwindstack DLL ABI.

libsigchain.reason: Linux emits upstream libsigchain; Windows supplies the same logical shared target from native/cmake/ArtPlatform.cmake and sigchain_windows.cc.
